About me

I’m a designer who cares about intuitive digital experiences and strong visual identities. I work across product design, graphic design and digital marketing, so the app, the poster and the post all feel like they belong together. I combine creativity with problem-solving, and I’m always learning, with the goal of creating experiences that make a difference.

Product design

UI and UX design for mobile apps and the web.

Makvia

  • Mobile app
  • Booking
  • UI / UX

A mobile app that connects makeup artists with clients who want makeup services. Clients sign in, browse artists by style, filter by location and price, view portfolios, reviews and services, request a booking and get a confirmation.

My Modesty

  • Mobile app
  • E-commerce
  • UI / UX

A shopping app for women who want modest outfits, under the line “Elevate your modest style.” A dark interface lets the orange brand color and the clothing photography lead, from a splash screen and a new collection banner with category shortcuts to colour and size choices and an Add to cart button on each product.

Vivid Horizons

  • Website
  • Travel
  • Brand identity
  • UI / UX

A website and brand identity for a luxury travel agency in Zimbabwe. The site opens with a full-bleed landscape hero and moves through about, tour categories, why choose us, client testimonials and a newsletter sign up. The brand board sets the colour palette, the Poppins and Cormorant Garamond type pairing, keywords and the feeling of the brand.

Maintena

  • Website
  • Web app
  • UI / UX

The website and entry screen for Maintena, an asset intelligence engine for industrial maintenance. Seven website pages cover the home page, about, how it works, asset management, preventive maintenance, inventory and reports, and contact. The entry screen reports live telemetry sync before the plant hub. Use the tabs to browse six more pages: About, How it works, asset management, preventive maintenance, inventory and reports, and contact.
